# Machine Health Log

Standing steward: `role:machine-health` (`pij-logical-canid`).
Scope: shared Mac (`M4 Max`, 16 cores, 128 GB RAM, 2.0 TB APFS). Read-only by default; never delete or kill without prime's go, never by pattern.

---

## 2026-11-25 — Baseline + Cross-Repo History of Recurring Machine-Health Incidents

### Current state (2026-11-25 13:21–13:28 AEST)
- **Disk:** `/System/Volumes/Data` at **99% used, 21 GiB free** (dropped from 24 GiB at 13:21 to 21 GiB at 13:28 — **below `PIJ_DISK_FLOOR_GB=25`**, blocking pij shared builds/deploys).
  - Raw baseline saved: `readings/20261125T132101-df.txt`.
  - APFS local snapshots: **none** (`tmutil listlocalsnapshots /` empty).
  - OrbStack VM image (`~/Library/Group Containers/HUAQ24HBR6.dev.orbstack/data/data.img.raw`): **180 GB** allocated on disk (sparse 1.9T).
  - Nightly cleaner `dev.adventure.disk-clean` (`~/Library/Logs/adv-disk-clean.log`) shows free space sliding over its last 4 runs: `113 GB -> 65 GB -> 21 GB -> 23 GB` (scoped to adventure targets only; `uv cache clean` exiting 2, `pnpm store prune` exiting 226).
- **Load:** `45.21 / 41.98 / 41.47` (up 9d 1h22m). Note: `du` / `docker system df` stall/time out under this I/O + Defender load.

### Recurring root causes across past investigations (cross-repo `flowspace3` conversation history)

Searched conversations across all indexed repos (`pij`, `flowspace3`, `osk_central`, `chainglass`, `adventure-game`, `unimatrix`, `ai-manu`, `eldenring`, `unasphere`). Every incident on this Mac falls into the same 6 patterns:

#### 1. Per-worktree Rust `target/` directories (top repeat disk offender)
- **Pattern:** Worktrees across `~/pi-hacking`, `~/substrate/flowspace`, `~/games/unasphere`, `~/games/adventure`, and `~/osk` build into separate `target/` directories (5–17 GB each). Merged/idle worktrees accumulate until the disk hits 0–25 GB free.
- **Prior incidents:**
  - **2026-09-02** (`flowspace3` `conv:39eab20f#t140`, `pij` `conv:160ac95b#t1905,#t1934,#t1991`): Host hit 587 MiB free; **killed OrbStack VM** (`StorageFull` → BTRFS abort, Docker socket vanished). Primary cause was ~106 GB of per-worktree Cargo `target/` dirs across flowspace3 + pij worktrees, not Docker volumes. Deleting stale targets + merged worktrees recovered disk.
  - **2026-10-05 & 2026-10-07** (`pij` `conv:38a0dfc9#t7290,#t7544`, `chainglass` `conv:8ad794c1#t61`): Disk hit 609 MiB free (`ENOSPC`). Deleting 17 unused pij `target/` dirs recovered 33 → 200 GB; another sweep deleted 124 stale `target/` dirs across repos (37 → 478 GB).
  - **2026-10-11** (`adventure-game` `conv:6ead0a70#t6645,#t6728`): Survey found ~280 GB of `target/` dirs across the Mac (`pi-hacking`, `flowspace`, `unasphere`). Cleanup recovered 122 → 399 GB and installed `dev.adventure.disk-clean` (4am LaunchAgent, **adventure-only**).
  - **2026-11-10** (`pij` `conv:d0abc2d8#t453`): Disk hit floor again; `pij-loud-stoat` deleted untouched `target/` dirs in `~/pi-hacking`.
- **Why it keeps recurring:** `pij` adopted shared `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` (F217), but other repos/worktrees (`flowspace`, `unasphere`, `unimatrix`, `chainglass`, etc.) still create per-worktree `target/` dirs, and `dev.adventure.disk-clean` only cleans `adventure`.

#### 2. Unbounded `.turbo/cache` and tool/package caches
- **Pattern:** Turborepo local cache eviction (`cacheMaxAge` / `cacheMaxSize`) is off by default, and worktrees write into the main checkout's `.turbo/cache`. Also `git-ai` metrics DB, `uv` cache, `npm`/`pnpm` caches, Xcode `DeviceSupport`/`CoreSimulator`.
- **Prior incidents:**
  - **2026-08-28** (`flowspace3` `conv:aeffcf91#t60`, `~/substrate/flowspace/flowspace3/scratch/disk-usage-report-2026-08-28.md`): `~/substrate/chainglass/.turbo/cache` reached **255 GB** (caching `.next/dev` into every build tarball). Fixed in chainglass only.
  - **2026-10-29** (`osk_central` `conv:efd5b1fa#t3520`, `~/osk/osk_central/scratch/reports/disk-usage.md`): Exact same bug hit `~/osk/osk_central/.turbo/cache` (**90 GB**, 68.8 GB in one day). Fixed in OSK PR #134 (`cacheMaxAge: 24h`, `cacheMaxSize: 20GB`, exclude `.next/dev/**`).
  - **2026-10-07** (`chainglass` `conv:8ad794c1#t61`): `~/.git-ai/internal/metrics-db` grew to **11 GB**; `uv` cache reached **21 GB** (locked by running `uv`).
  - **2026-08-28 & 2026-10-07**: `~/Library/Developer` (`CoreSimulator` + `iOS/watchOS DeviceSupport`) holds ~47–68 GB permanently unless pruned.
- **Why it keeps recurring:** Fixes are applied per-repo instead of fleet-wide; new repos/caches (`~/.copilot`, `uv`, `turbo`, `git-ai`) lack retention caps.

#### 3. OrbStack VM image bloat, memory ballooning, and CPU spikes
- **Pattern:** `OrbStack Helper` periodically balloons to 17–28 GB RAM and 180–627% CPU, starving memory/swap and causing input stutter or full hangs. Its `data.img.raw` grows to 120–180 GB and **does not shrink back to host APFS** after in-VM Docker prunes without trim/restart. Also, host disk exhaustion kills the VM with BTRFS `StorageFull`.
- **Prior incidents:**
  - **2026-10-19** (`ai-manu` `conv:6880782c#t9,#t21`): OrbStack Helper at 180–290% CPU / 22 GB RAM; restart dropped it to 2% CPU / 3.6 GB (caveat: containers without restart policies stay down).
  - **2026-10-26** (`pij` `conv:38a0dfc9#t10006`): Full Mac hang (hard power-off) preceded by OrbStack 188% CPU + Defender 180% CPU + load 113.
  - **2026-11-22** (`pij` `conv:38a0dfc9#t17829`): OrbStack at 28 GB RAM / 210% CPU, swap 11.1/12.3 GB full.
  - **2026-11-12** (`unimatrix` `conv:39902ff3#t156`, `machine-load-investigation.md`): Explicitly proved OrbStack is **not always** the cause — load stayed 80–188 with OrbStack down.

#### 4. Microsoft Defender (`wdavdaemon` / `epsext` / `dlpdaemon`) amplified by file churn & process launches
- **Pattern:** Corp-managed Defender scans every process launch and file write (150–380% CPU baseline under build/test churn). High load averages (50–220) with low CPU idle or I/O stalls are routinely Defender + Spotlight (`mds_stores`) reacting to concurrent Cargo builds, worktree copies, temp dirs, or statusline hook storms.
- **Prior incidents:**
  - **2026-10-12** (`pij` `conv:7a2eb26d#t8`): Desktop stutter, load 44–52; Defender ~330% CPU scanning concurrent Cargo clippy/check.
  - **2026-11-06** (`pij` `conv:38a0dfc9#t12302`): Load 118 from Defender + OrbStack + 106 Claude / 334 Node processes + concurrent tests across repos.
  - **2026-11-12** (`unimatrix` `conv:d0abc2d8#t841`, `machine-load-investigation.md`): ~250–550 process launches/sec (pij shell statusline hooks across ~100 seats + tmux `cat` taps) driving ~160–250% Defender/DLP CPU. Led to `pij-rs` native statusline, persistent `tmux -C` control client, and `AGENTS.md` resource-cost rules.

#### 5. Memory overcommit from total active agent seat count (100+ seats on 128 GB)
- **Pattern:** 50–150 concurrent agent sessions (`copilot`, `claude`, `omp`) + per-seat MCP servers + parallel `next dev`/Playwright/Vitest runs push footprint to ~150 GB on 128 GB RAM, saturating the compressor (80–105 GB) and swap (8–12 GB), causing `kernel_task` thrashing and load 100+.
- **Prior incidents:**
  - **2026-11-10** (`pij` `conv:c78c3374#t18`): 52 Copilot sessions (~320–400% CPU) + Defender (~175%) → load 118–220.
  - **2026-11-12** (`unimatrix` `machine-load-investigation.md`): 107 agent panes (49 copilot, 37 claude, 22 omp) → 145–157 GB footprint, compressor 82–105 GB, swap full.

#### 6. Leaked temp files, unbounded logs/taps, and stray processes
- **Pattern:** Test fixtures leaving `/tmp` dirs or stale tmux sockets (~48,000 stale tmux sockets found 2026-11-22 in `conv:38a0dfc9#t17829`), unbounded daemon pane tap files (3.2 GB in `conv:38a0dfc9#t10478`, later fixed with mtime-braked sweep), private-daemon synthetic replay stores (`conv:fb0e1c49#t414`), runaway `bun` processes (`conv:24005730#t15`), and `lghub_updater`.

### What's already built vs what's missing
- **Exists:** `pij` shared `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` + `PIJ_DISK_FLOOR_GB=25`; `chainglass` & `osk_central` `.turbo/cache` caps; `dev.adventure.disk-clean` nightly cleaner (adventure-only); `osk_central` guard-only LaunchAgent design (`conv:0ea8cc30#t294`: alert <100/<50/<25 GiB, never auto-delete).
- **Missing (why it keeps happening):**
  1. No machine-wide disk guard/alert before hitting 25 GiB (free space silently dropped 113 → 65 → 21 GiB over 4 nights).
  2. Non-pij repos still accumulate per-worktree `target/` dirs and uncapped caches.
  3. No single owner running a cheap targeted check of the known 6 offenders before builds fail or OrbStack aborts.

### Recommended actions for prime / Jordan
1. **Immediate (disk is at 21 GiB — below pij's 25 GiB build floor):**
   - Authorize a targeted, read-only size check of the known repeat offenders (one repo root at a time, not a whole-home `du` which stalls under load 45): per-worktree `target/` dirs in `~/substrate`, `~/games`, `~/github`, `~/repos`, `~/osk`, `~/pi-hacking`; `.turbo/cache` dirs; `~/.git-ai/internal/metrics-db`; `~/.copilot/{logs,session-state}`; `~/.cache/uv`; `docker system df` inside OrbStack.
   - Do **not** let free space fall further — last time it hit ~0.5 GB, OrbStack's VM died with a BTRFS abort and knocked out all Postgres containers (`flowspace3-db`, etc.).
2. **Structural (stop re-investigating the same 6 things):**
   - Put a single **guard-only** alert (e.g. alert prime/Jordan at <100 / <50 / <30 GiB) instead of waiting for `PIJ_DISK_FLOOR_GB=25` to fail builds.
   - Adopt shared `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` (or worktree-teardown `target/` cleanup) across non-pij Rust repos (`flowspace`, `unasphere`, `unimatrix`, `chainglass`).
   - Check why `dev.adventure.disk-clean` is failing on `uv cache clean` (exit 2) and `pnpm store prune` (exit 226).
   - Cap/rotate agent logs (`~/.copilot`) and check `~/.git-ai/internal/metrics-db`.
   - Enforce a seat-count / concurrency ceiling when load >30 or swap >80%.

## 2026-11-25 14:02–14:04 AEST — Executed Jordan-approved `git-ai` metrics-db deletion

- **Authority:** Jordan approved via prime `pij-kind-parrotfish` (14:02).
- **Before:**
  - `/Users/jordanknight/.git-ai/internal/metrics-db`: **25,173,712,896 B (23.44 GiB / 25.17 GB)**, open by PID `2065` (`/Users/jordanknight/.git-ai/bin/git-ai bg run`).
  - `/System/Volumes/Data`: **28,520,436 KiB (~27.2 GiB / 28G)** free (99% used).
- **Action:**
  1. Sent `SIGTERM` to PID `2065` (exited cleanly).
  2. A Copilot checkpoint hook immediately respawned `git-ai bg run` as PID `56472`, which reopened the same inode (`902349173`) before `rm`.
  3. Unlinked `/Users/jordanknight/.git-ai/internal/metrics-db` (exact path, no globs), then sent `SIGTERM` to PID `56472` to release the unlinked 23.44 GiB inode.
- **After (14:03–14:04):**
  - `/System/Volumes/Data`: **52,702,708 KiB (~50.3 GiB / 51G)** free (98% used) — **~23.1 GiB (~24.8 GB) freed** (`28,520,436 -> 52,702,708 KiB`).
- **Did `git-ai` restart and resume writing?** **Yes, immediately (within ~2 seconds).**
  - Respawned as PID `71634` (`git-ai bg run`, `git-ai 1.6.21`) via Copilot CLI checkpoint hooks.
  - Immediately recreated `/Users/jordanknight/.git-ai/internal/metrics-db` + `-wal` (`2.5 MiB` within ~30s, **686 rows / 1.26 MB JSON**, growing +46 rows / +73 KB in 10s).
- **Root cause of unbounded growth (observed in schema + binary strings + `git-ai bg tail`):**
  - `feature_flags.transcript_streaming: true` and `feature_flags.transcript_sweep: true` (both enabled by default) sweep `~/.copilot/session-state/*/events.jsonl` (7-day lookback) and insert every Copilot CLI event (`event_kind=5`) into `metrics` with `delivered_ts = NULL`.
  - Because there is no `api_key` / login configured (`flush-metrics-db: skipping (requires an API key or login)`), rows are **never flushed or pruned** — `metrics-db` grows forever.
- **Supported config options (NOT applied — awaiting Jordan's go):**
  1. Disable transcript streaming & sweeping (stops the `event_kind=5` flood into `metrics-db`):
     - `git-ai config --add feature_flags.transcript_streaming false`
     - `git-ai config --add feature_flags.transcript_sweep false`
     - `git-ai config set telemetry_oss off`
     - then `git-ai bg restart`
